recipes.notes: lich-c-edit-b-2 changed nothing; a single-focus instruction for the purple and crimson lining only.

recipes.editInstruction: Remove the small blue flames around him and bring both arms in closer to his body, so he is a little narrower with empty transparent space at the left and right edges of the image. Keep the stitched pale blue-grey face, the iron shoulder plates, the blue-grey fists in manacles with broken chains, the red smock, colours, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: abomination-b-edit-2 is accepted art but 82 px wide: its left arm reaches the CHIBI HP bar strip, and a giant's anchor cannot move (4 px side overflow limit).

recipes.editInstruction: Move his left arm (on the left side of the image) in against his belly so his left fist, manacle and broken chain sit in front of the red smock, and remove the blue flames on the left side, leaving the left edge of the image empty below the shoulder plate. Keep the stitched pale blue-grey face, the iron shoulder plates, the right arm, the manacles with broken chains, colours, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: abomination-b-edit-3 lost the chains and stayed as wide; the left arm and flames of abomination-b-edit-2 are what reach the CHIBI HP bar strip.
